description: This file defines the 'Event' class within the 'Opencart.Catalog.Model.Setting' namespace. The class extends a system engine model and provides a method to retrieve active events from the database, specifically from the 'event' table where status is active, ordered by sort order.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents the event model for the catalog setting module, providing functionality to retrieve event data from the database.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves all active events from the database, ordered by their sort order.
